verdict.rationale: Relay is a business banking and spend-management platform. Products of this kind can plausibly offer travel booking and price-drop rebooking, so the axis applies. The evidence covers cards, spend limits, receipts, bill pay, invoicing and auto-transfers, but nothing on travel booking, rate monitoring or automatic rebooking.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have booked travel rates automatically monitored and rebooked when prices drop
